definition: Share of total energy consumption obtained from renewable sources
calculation_method: Renewable energy consumption / Total energy consumption * 100
Total energy consumption in MWh / Revenue in INR crore

definition: Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions relative to revenue
calculation_method: (Scope 1 emissions + Scope 2 emissions) in tCO2e / Revenue in INR crore
Total water consumption in kilolitres / Revenue in INR crore

definition: Share of total waste generated that is reused recycled or recovered
calculation_method: (Waste reused + Waste recycled + Waste recovered) / Total waste generated * 100

definition: Frequency of lost time injuries relative to employee working hours
calculation_method: Lost time injuries / Total person hours worked * 1000000

definition: Percentage of total workforce represented by women
calculation_method: Number of women employees / Total employees * 100

definition: Percentage of board members who are independent directors
calculation_method: Number of independent directors / Total board directors * 100
